error.message:
newspec-c: failed → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue; part of it is a known gap))
Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Two phases, each with a patient set to New Admission on the server's yesterday and a note generated on the phone (scripted model answer): (a) phone one day ahead (JST), (b) phone at the real time in Pacific/Honolulu. Same on both devices: the badge rolled to Follow-up once, the pre-selected note format (SOAP progress) and the course timeline lines (server-clock label, TFA-92589). Different (6 of 12 checks fail): (a) the phone's card lacks 'NEW TODAY'; the note's generated-at stamp is written with the phone's clock, so the phone AND the computer show the note as '2:45 AM · Oct 16' on Oct 15; stored transcriptDate 'Fri Oct 16 2026' vs the server's Oct 15. (b) note screen dates Oct 14 (phone) vs Oct 15 (computer); transcriptDate 'Wed Oct 14 2026'. Known: TFA-92584 AC 8 / B18 (day roll and transcriptDate follow the device clock); the note-time instance is the same class. Hospital day / visit number are not shown on main (B23).
Product issue: With a phone whose clock is a day ahead, a note generated on it is shown as tomorrow's on every device ('2:45 AM · Oct 16' on Oct 15) and its transcript is filed under tomorrow; the phone's list also drops the 'New today' tag (known B18 / TFA-92584 AC 8).

descriptionHtml:
Bug B18 · P1 · known

Many dates and times follow the device clock instead of server time (UAT 3.8): 'NEW TODAY', admit date, vitals date, task done time, transcript date; with a phone two days slow a held drug is stamped two days back and the next cleanup deletes it

Tickets: TFA-92584 ready for qa (UAT 3.8); TFA-92597 ready for qa (R6); TFA-92579 AC 3/4 ready for qa (NEW TODAY); TFA-94745 ready for qa (draft restore) · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Root cause known (Daniela asked for server time on 10-03); the deleted drug, missing badge and wrong draft restore are new symptoms. TC-16/S18 (UAT 3.8, one device set to the wrong date): a phone a day ahead files its bedside line in a row dated tomorrow on the shared record, and the next write from a correctly clocked device lists the lines before it twice (the transcript archive trusts the device date). Which calendar day a correct device should use when its local day and the server's UTC day differ is the open question Q9 (D10); TC-16/S25 passed otherwise. Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92579/92584): a browser whose day is ahead writes the badge roll back to the server, and every device shows Follow-up, with the matching template and billing family (TC-01/S08, TC-20/S20a; TFA-92584 AC 8). The failing cell of TC-25/S24a is the card's NEW TODAY, which compares addedAt with the device's date (PatientCard.tsx:154-156). EFS/S28 (a)(b) restore drafts by the device date (TFA-94745); (c), an old draft put in today's box, is B13's. Review 2026-10-15 (TFA-94514): the analytics day is the device date too (pilotUsageEvents / pilotDailyRounding use localDay()): a phone 3 days ahead files its rows under its own day, and an encounter across the phone midnight is split over two days and never timed (OAT-06/S10). Re-test 2026-10-16 (TC-21/S26, 25acd727): a browser two days ahead writes the badge roll with its own future day (encTypeDay 2026-10-19) to the shared record, so the correct-clock browser shows Follow-up too.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S08, TC-10/S22, TC-12/S23, TC-19/S19, TC-22/S23, TC-25/S24a, TC-02/S13b, EFS/S28, TC-16/S18, TC-06/S19, OAT-06/S10, TC-06/S23, TC-21/S22, TC-19/S23, TC-21/S26

Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S24b Real phone on the wrong date or another time zone shows the same state as the computer

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Time-based state uses the server clock: a device with a wrong clock, no clock set or another time zone shows the same state as the other device (badge after the day roll, hospital day / visit number, … (UAT 3.8; TFA-92584 AC 8)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Computer on the correct clock (JST); a real phone with its device clock set one day ahead, then to UTC-10. {hospitalPatient} set to New Admission yesterday (server time)

When Open the list and the chart on both; generate a note on the phone

Then Both show the same badge (rolled to Follow-up once), the same hospital day / visit number, and the same 'today' date on the note and the timeline

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): A person compares the two screens field by field; any difference is a Fail. Known: TFA-92584 (day roll and transcriptDate use the device clock). The web half is automated in S24a

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S24b is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-25.matrix.json; a letter suffix = one case split in several), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-25/S24b

Real phone on the wrong date or another time zone shows the same state as the computer

Tickets: TFA-92584 Admission Status Toggle (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue; part of it is a known gap)).

Detail:

Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Two phases, each with a patient set to New Admission on the server's yesterday and a note generated on the phone (scripted model answer): (a) phone one day ahead (JST), (b) phone at the real time in Pacific/Honolulu. Same on both devices: the badge rolled to Follow-up once, the pre-selected note format (SOAP progress) and the course timeline lines (server-clock label, TFA-92589). Different (6 of 12 checks fail): (a) the phone's card lacks 'NEW TODAY'; the note's generated-at stamp is written with the phone's clock, so the phone AND the computer show the note as '2:45 AM · Oct 16' on Oct 15; stored transcriptDate 'Fri Oct 16 2026' vs the server's Oct 15. (b) note screen dates Oct 14 (phone) vs Oct 15 (computer); transcriptDate 'Wed Oct 14 2026'. Known: TFA-92584 AC 8 / B18 (day roll and transcriptDate follow the device clock); the note-time instance is the same class. Hospital day / visit number are not shown on main (B23).

Product issue: With a phone whose clock is a day ahead, a note generated on it is shown as tomorrow's on every device ('2:45 AM · Oct 16' on Oct 15) and its transcript is filed under tomorrow; the phone's list also drops the 'New today' tag (known B18 / TFA-92584 AC 8).

Known gap (known): true

Evidence: 11 attached.

Dev run: skipped: set-aside — set-aside: iOS/Android (Quinn 2026-10-14) — A real phone with its own clock and time zone changed: iOS and Android are set aside for the dev run (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
